To reproduce run llc with the following test
```
; ModuleID = 'reduced.ll'
source_filename = "reduced.ll"
target datalayout = "e-m:e-p270:32:32-p271:32:32-p272:64:64-i64:64-i128:128-f80:128-n8:16:32:64-S128-ni:1-p2:32:8:8:32-ni:2"
target triple = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"

define void @widget(i64 %arg, <8 x i8> %arg1) gc "statepoint-example" {
bb:
  %call = call i64 @llvm.cttz.i64(i64 %arg, i1 false)
  %trunc = trunc i64 %call to i8
  %lshr = lshr i8 %trunc, 3
  %extractelement = extractelement <8 x i8> %arg1, i8 %lshr
  %freeze = freeze i8 %extractelement
  %zext = zext i8 %freeze to i32
  store i32 %zext, ptr addrspace(1) null, align 4
  ret void
}
```

comments.author: RKSimon
comments.body:
```
SelectionDAG has 19 nodes:
  t0: ch,glue = EntryToken
            t9: v16i8,ch = CopyFromReg t0, Register:v16i8 %5
                    t2: i64,ch = CopyFromReg t0, Register:i64 %2
                  t4: i64 = AssertZext t2, ValueType:ch:i7
                t5: i8 = truncate t4
              t7: i8 = srl t5, Constant:i8<3>
            t12: i64 = zero_extend t7
          t20: i8 = extract_vector_elt t9, t12
        t14: i8 = freeze t20
      t15: i32 = zero_extend t14
    t17: ch = store<(store (s32) into `ptr addrspace(1) null`, addrspace 1)> t0, t15, Constant:i64<0>, undef:i64
  t19: ch = X86ISD::RET_GLUE t17, TargetConstant:i32<0>
```
We're freezing the extract_vector_elt index and then the ComputeKnownBits fails to see through the freeze.

Looking at a fix.
